messages:
Maya: quick thought  run a 3-week 'starter sprint' for byte-sized tutorials + an OSS launch post. goals: fast first-run, clear benchmark story, and a simple inbound funnel.
Jon: yes. keep each tutorial <15m. structure: 1) Hello World quickstart (5m), 2) App integration (12m), 3) Optimize & scale (15m).
Renee: will draft the OSS announcement emphasizing contributor FAQ and a short migration note for users on other runtimes. include a LICENSE blurb.
Ibrahim: I'll produce perf snapshots: tokens/sec, p50, and $/1k tokens for baseline vs q8 quant. we'll publish a tiny CSV appendix.
Maya: webinar? propose a 30m demo + 15m community Q&A the week after launch. capture registrants with the mini-lab signups.
Jon: landing copy options: "Start in 5 minutes" vs "Reduce inference cost by ~X%". A/B test headline and CTA.
Renee: marketing assets: 2 hero cards, one GIF showing the quickstart run, and a 60s embed for docs. also prepare a 3-tweet thread and LinkedIn post.
Ibrahim: infra booked Tue-Thu next week. will upload anonymized sample data to S3 and add perf logs to the repo.
Maya: closed beta: invite 8 community devs, gather quotes for the blog. include a short survey about latency and ease-of-use.
Jon: for the benchmark narrative
void flashy claims. show before/after with batching + quantization, include config snippets. example snippet: ```json
{"batch_size":8,"quant":"q8_0"}
```
Renee: add contributor checklist to the repo: PR template, testing instructions, small label taxonomy. also note code of conduct link.
ops-bot: created calendar event "starter-sprint kickoff" Wed 09:30  invites: Maya, Jon, Renee, Ibrahim. board: https://git.redwood/internal/refapps/starter-sprint/board
Maya: next actions: Jon + Renee draft outlines by EOD Thu; Ibrahim run perf sweeps Fri; ops-bot  create ticket for AB test and webinar registration flow.
ops-bot: tasks added: outline draft, perf CSV upload, design assets, closed beta invites, AB test setup.
